title: SRT3 GPU & Power
description: RTX 3070 on Ryzenous in depth, plus per-outlet power, energy and cost.

panels.title: GPU + memory-controller utilization
panels.description: Cores = compute busy. Memory bus = VRAM bandwidth busy (LLM token generation is usually memory-bound).

panels.title: VRAM
panels.description: 8 GB. A model that doesn't fit spills to system RAM and gets ~10x slower.

panels.title: Power draw vs limit
panels.description: When draw hugs the limit, the card is power-throttling.

panels.title: Why is it slowing down? (throttle reasons)
panels.description: Lit bar = that reason is active. Idle is normal. Power cap under load is normal. Thermal is not.
